quiz.title: Find Your Connection Method in 1 Minute
quiz.subtitle: Answer 3 quick questions and get tailored instructions for your IPTV provider
quiz.q1: 1. What credentials did your IPTV provider give you?
quiz.q1_opt2: Server URL, Username, and Password (Xtream Codes)
quiz.q1_opt3: Stalker/Ministra portal URL and MAC address binding
quiz.q2: 2. What device will you be using?
quiz.q2_opt1: Television or Android TV streaming box
quiz.q3: 3. Did your provider provide an EPG guide URL?
quiz.q3_opt1: Yes, I have an XMLTV URL or it's built into the playlist
quiz.q3_opt2: No EPG URL provided (I need an automatic guide)
quiz.m3uTip: Choose 'M3U Playlist' in the Add Source menu. Paste your provider link. TV guide and logos will sync automatically.
quiz.xtreamTip: Choose 'Xtream Codes' in the Add Source menu. Enter server URL, username, and password. Live streams and VOD will load seamlessly.
quiz.stalkerTip: Choose 'Stalker' in the Add Source menu. Enter your portal URL. Use the built-in MAC generator or enter your registered MAC address.
quiz.epgTip: No separate EPG search needed: YAiPlayer automatically activates built-in fallback guide sources for channels without program data.

download.installGuideTitle: How to Enable Unknown Sources for APK Installation
download.step1: 1. Download the APK file on your device via browser (or transfer using a USB flash drive for TV).
download.step2: 2. Open the file. In the Android security prompt, select 'Settings' and enable 'Allow from this source'.
download.step3: 3. Return to the prompt and tap 'Install'. Once completed, launch YAiPlayer.
download.inAppUpdateText: Once installed, navigate to 'About' → 'Check for Updates' inside YAiPlayer. The app will automatically notify you and update when a new version is published.

checklist.title: Checklist: 5-Minute IPTV Provider & Setup Guide
checklist.subtitle: A step-by-step checklist to test provider quality and configure your player for stutter-free playback.
checklist.step1Desc: HD and 4K streaming requires stable 30+ Mbps speed with low latency (ping < 50ms). Prefer 5 GHz Wi-Fi or Ethernet cable over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi for TV streaming.
checklist.step2Desc: Determine whether your provider supplies M3U links, Xtream Codes credentials, or Stalker/Ministra portal access with MAC binding.
checklist.step3Desc: Check with your provider how many days of archive are stored (typically 3 to 7 days). YAiPlayer automatically detects tvg-rec and flussonic archive flags.
checklist.step4Desc: Copy the XMLTV link if provided. If absent, YAiPlayer will seamlessly use its built-in fallback EPG sources.
checklist.step5Desc: Get the official APK via Telegram bot @YAiPlayer_App_bot for TV or phone and allow unknown source installation.
checklist.step6Title: 6. Add Your Source to the Player
checklist.step6Desc: Tap '+ Add Source', choose your source type, and enter your credentials. Channels and groups will sync immediately.
checklist.step7Desc: Turn on Quick Channel Start in the TV sidebar or profile menu to resume your favorite channel immediately on app launch.
checklist.completeDesc: Your player is configured for top performance and reliable streaming. Enjoy watching!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding YAiPlayer features, security, and setup.
faq.q1: What is YAiPlayer and what is it used for?
faq.a1: YAiPlayer is a modern open-source (GPL-3.0) media player designed for streaming IPTV on Android TV and mobile devices. It unites live channels, TV guide (EPG), catch-up archives, and VOD media libraries into a seamless interface.
faq.q2: Where do I get TV channels and movies?
faq.a2: YAiPlayer is strictly a playback client. It contains no pre-installed media. You provide your own M3U playlist, Xtream Codes credentials, or Stalker portal from your licensed IPTV provider.
faq.a3: Yes, completely safe. The app has no trackers, no third-party telemetry, and no ad libraries. The code is publicly auditable on GitHub, and your credentials stay stored locally on your device.
faq.q4: Which formats and portals are supported?
faq.a4: YAiPlayer supports M3U/M3U8 playlists (including #EXTGRP and tvg-rec tags), Xtream Codes API (live streams + VOD), and Stalker/Ministra portals via MAC address or user login.
faq.q5: How does catch-up archive playback work?
faq.a5: If your provider supports archives, YAiPlayer recognizes available past days in the EPG grid. You can rewind live broadcasts or play past shows directly from the program schedule.
faq.q6: How do I update the application?
faq.a6: You can update directly inside the app under 'About' → 'Check for Updates'. New APKs are also always available via Telegram bot @YAiPlayer_App_bot and on this website.
faq.a7: Yes. YAiPlayer is free with zero subscriptions, no hidden paywalls, and no advertisements. The GPL-3.0 license ensures it remains open.
